name: skillsmith
description: Craft and upkeep of skills. Authoring reference (the vocabulary and principles that make a skill predictable) plus provenance tracking for borrowed work: compares an adapted skill to its pinned upstream, flags behavioral drift and fabricated attributions, and refreshes the reviewed commit SHA. Houses writing-great-skills and upstream-review.

interface.longDescription: Authoring reference for writing predictable skills, plus provenance tracking that compares an adapted skill to its pinned upstream and flags behavioral drift or fabricated attributions.
defaultPrompt: Review this adapted skill against its upstream source.
